biggest_catch: There is no annual fee, so the math is clean: 20,000 miles (about $200 in travel value at 1 cent per mile through Capital One Travel) after $500 in 3 months — the only real cost is meeting the spend with money you were spending anyway.
catches: Claim the bonus only with spending you already planned; never buy things you don't need just to hit the $500 target.
No annual fee on this card, so the fee does not eat the bonus — the first-year net math is in the biggest catch above.
Applying for the card causes a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily lower your credit score.
The purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance wipes out the small bonus fast — pay the statement balance in full every month.
You are ineligible if you received a new-cardmember bonus for a VentureOne, Venture, or Venture X account in the past 48 months.
The bonus posts within two billing cycles, not immediately — keep the account open until it lands.

steps: Go to the official Capital One page https://www.capitalone.com/credit-cards/travel-and-miles/ and read the VentureOne welcome-bonus terms (20,000 miles after $500 in 3 months).
Confirm you have not received a VentureOne, Venture, or Venture X new-cardmember bonus in the past 48 months.
Apply online through that official page and get approved.
Within the first 3 months, put $500 of already-planned purchases on the card — never extra spending for the bonus.
Pay the statement balance in full every month at ~20%+ APR; do not carry a balance.
Watch for the 20,000 miles to post within two billing cycles of hitting the spend.
timing: Bonus miles post within two billing cycles after you meet the $500-in-3-months spend requirement.
